name: Flaxen Fabric Table Lamp
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted with high-quality flaxen fabric, this table lamp offers a natural texture that softly diffuses light for a cozy ambiance.
  • The sturdy wooden base adds durability and a minimalist aesthetic, while the anti-slip EVA foam pad ensures stable placement on any surface.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Lampshade height: 18 cm (7.09 inches)
  • Total height: 26.5 cm (10.43 inches)
  • Shade diameter: 10 cm (3.94 inches)
  • Base diameter: 13.2 cm (5.2 inches)
  • Compact and versatile, it fits perfectly on bedside tables, desks, or shelves.
     
Printing Technology:

With UV printing method, your custom design is vividly transferred onto the flaxen fabric surface. The print maintains excellent color clarity while allowing light to pass through beautifully, creating a soft glowing effect.

 

Functionality Use:
  • 3 lighting modes: White light, Yellow light, and Warm yellow light
  • Adjustable brightness (brighter / softer)
  • Easy button control for switching modes and power
  • USB-powered for flexible use anywhere

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
A thoughtful and practical gift for birthdays, housewarmings, anniversaries, holidays, or special celebrations. Personalize it with meaningful designs, names, or messages to create a unique keepsake your loved ones will cherish every day.

 

Specification
  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
